conventions.angles: radians unless the key ends in Deg; thetaS = half-angle across the viewport SHORT side
conventions.lens: r = F * tan(k*theta)/k (k: 1 rectilinear, 0.5 stereographic, ->0 equidistant); the scene is rendered rectilinear with tan half-extents (tx, ty) and remapped per pixel in the final pass; lateral CA scales r per channel by (1 -/+ ca)
conventions.colour: scene-linear HDR in (HDR worlds); wb / wbShade are linear RGB gains; EV values are log2 stops; clipEv = highlights hard-clip this many EV over the AE target
conventions.time: seconds; shutter = exposure time, readout = rolling-shutter top-to-bottom time

pipeline: shutter blur(analytic, rolling shutter, jello; McGuire-style silhouette reconstruction)
final(lens, CA, sharpen, WB, bloom, vignette, contrast, veil, camCurve+clip, toe, saturation, selective colour, S-curve, lift, grain)

grain.model: sigma = grain * exp2(max(ev + ev0, 0) * slope) * sqrt(luma + 0.025)

ssao.method: SAO-style: depth-derived normal, cos term, (1-vv/R^2)^2 falloff, bias 0.1, golden-angle spiral
ssao.apply: indirect *= mix(1, ao, 0.8) (world shader, contract C3)

lensSolve.method: fpvcam.js computeLens(): fit a crop of a 16:9 sensor into the viewport (short half-side = 1); F = max(focal for thetaS on the short side, focal that caps the corner at cornerCapRad); thc = corner angle; render frustum tan = tan(thc) * frustumMargin split by (hw, hh)/rc

jello.model: per axis i: w = 2*pi*hz*ratio[i]; phase += w*dt (CPU, mod 2pi); amp = jelloAmp*vib*axis[i]*sinc(w*shutter/2); hz = motion.hz (motor rpm, ~170 hover .. ~430 full), vib from rigCamera

exposure.model: GPU auto-exposure on a 1/8-res metering target with lag (aeUp / aeDown, s^-1), clamped to [evMin, evMax]; HDR luma pre-scale 16; uWhite = 1 / (1 - exp(-1.25*0.24*expo*2^clipEv))

bloom.model: bright-pass at the 1/8 metering target, separable 9-tap gaussian at unit tap spacing, run twice; strength look.bloom (x8 on 8-bit targets)

depthEncoding.note: contract C2: what fpvcam.depthMat writes into depthRT for the shutter blur

rig.mountNote: camera position = drone.pos + mountOffset rotated by the drone attitude (body frame: +x right, +y up, -z forward)
rig.note: Cine also pitches the view with the climb / dive angle, looks down the tube in a vertical drop and counter-pitches the fast nods (flight.js camView, advanced in step()). Live stabilisation = slerp with time constant stabTau[setting]

pipeline: scene: HDR half-float, MSAA (look.msaa) where RGBA16F multisampling exists; per-axis blur-aware render scale
depth: the collider (or world.depthScene) at half res into depthRT, packed log depth (depthEncoding)
blur: box shutter over look.shutter with rolling shutter (readout) + jello, up to look.maxSamples jittered taps, depth-aware silhouettes
down: 1/8 res metering luma + bloom bright-pass
final: barrel lens + CA + vignette, WB / shade WB, tone curve (expo, clipEv, toe, lift), veil, sky / green selection, saturation, sharpen, grain (grainEv), letterbox
